definitions.known_step: at least one head has known_mask == true
definitions.valid_mask_gap: consecutive step indices differ by > 1 or valid_mask == false

head_emit.description: A head emits on a step when all conditions are met

any_head_emit.description: Union of all heads that are known on this step
any_head_emit.formula: OR over heads: (known_mask[h] AND prob[h] >= threshold[h])
any_head_emit.unknown_handling: Head with known_mask=false is excluded from union (not counted as false)

persistent_emit.description: any_head_emit persists for >= k consecutive steps within an episode

streak_rules.reset: streak = 0 when any_head_emit == false OR valid_mask_gap OR episode_boundary

background_emit_manipulation.note: Typically ~0 because manipulation_known_mask is False on background

background_emit_any_known_head.note: Effectively grasp OR release since manipulation_known is ~always False on BG

episode_false_start.population: episodes with at least one background_step
episode_false_start.numerator: count(episodes where persistent_emit triggers at least once)

longest_background_streak.formula: max over episodes of max consecutive known-head any_head_emit

release_event_recall.population: release events (event_id >= 0, release_known_mask AND release_target both true within event)
release_event_recall.numerator: count(release events where persistent release_emit triggers)
release_event_recall.note: Event-level: an event is detected if ANY persistent window within it triggers

release_step_recall.population: steps within release events where release_known_mask AND release_target both true
release_step_recall.numerator: count(steps where release_prob >= threshold AND known AND target)
release_step_recall.note: Step-level: individual step classification, no persistence

release_overlap_emit_rate.population: steps where both grasp_known_mask AND release_known_mask are true
release_overlap_emit_rate.numerator: count(steps where grasp_prob >= threshold AND release_prob >= threshold)

vulnerable_window_coverage.note: DEFERRED — requires Codex V5 scheduler contract for candidate_close definition

mandatory_constraints.unknown_is_not_negative: Steps where known_mask[h] == false are excluded from denominator for head h
mandatory_constraints.unknown_never_emits: known_mask[h] == false → head h does not contribute to any_head_emit
mandatory_constraints.unknown_breaks_streak: Step where ALL heads have known_mask == false resets streak to 0
mandatory_constraints.episode_boundary_breaks_streak: Streak counter resets to 0 at episode start
mandatory_constraints.valid_mask_gap_breaks_streak: Non-consecutive step indices or valid_mask gap resets streak
mandatory_constraints.unsupported_route_never_emits: route_supported == false → all heads excluded, counted separately
mandatory_constraints.causal_only: No future-aware smoothing, no bidirectional context
mandatory_constraints.no_identity_specific_threshold: Thresholds must not depend on identity
mandatory_constraints.no_leakage: Calibration parameters must not be fit on evaluation data

replay_contract.note: This is a head-level threshold/persistence scan, NOT the actual V5 scheduler FSM
